candidates.name: Hepatocellular carcinoma
support_spans: polygonal to short spindle-shaped cells formed small nests and sheets within dilated sinusoids without encapsulation
tumor cells exhibited clear cell borders, high nuclear-to-cytoplasmic ratios, hyperchromatic nuclei, frequent mitotic figures, and sparse hepatocellular necrosis
candidates.why: The histological description of the tumor cells and their arrangement is consistent with hepatocellular carcinoma.

candidates.name: Hepatic hemangioma
support_spans: narrow spaces containing erythrocytes were noted between tumor cells
contradict_spans: local invasion into adjacent blood vessels was seen
candidates.why: The presence of erythrocytes between tumor cells could suggest a vascular tumor, but the invasive behavior is not typical of hemangioma.
